patch_description: The current greedy jitter search plateaus at min_area 0.01 (score 0.39). The bottleneck is that greedy single-point moves cannot coordinate all 11 points simultaneously. A much better approach for this kind of max-min problem is to optimize a smooth surrogate of the min: the softmin log-sum-exp over all 165 triangle doubled-areas, whose gradient w.r.t. the barycentric coordinates is computable in closed form via vectorized numpy. Running Adam on this smooth objective pushes area values into near-degeneracy (many triangles near the min), then we harden the temperature (lower softmin sharpness) and finish with the existing local search as a polish step. This directly attacks the plateau and is the classic way to escape greedy local optima in Heilbronn-style packing problems.
